description: Watch and tap a live iOS Simulator in the thread side panel while you and your agent build the app. Pick a device and press Start to embed serve-sim's own preview, with touch, keyboard, home, screenshots, recording and Safari Web Inspector. Agents start it with bb serve-sim and drive the same device with serve-sim's tap, type and button commands while you watch. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac with Xcode and Node.js 20+, and BB Desktop on that Mac; serve-sim downloads through npx on first start.
